# Vishwaclaudema

> Start building with Claude the right way, and find the tools worth having. Independent and unofficial. Not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Anthropic.

## Start building
- [Start a website or web app](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/website/): Sites and web apps (Next.js, React, Astro and the like).
- [Start an app that uses Claude](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/ai-feature/): Anything that sends prompts to Claude through the API or an SDK.
- [Start a mobile app](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/mobile/): Expo, React Native or Swift apps.
- [Start an automation](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/automation/): Scripts, crons, bots and anything that should run without you.
- [Start a writing or documents project](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/start/writing/): Reports, proposals, research and decks, mostly outside code.

## Discover
- [Discover](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/discover/): search 3,483 Claude skills, plugins and MCP servers from Anthropic's catalogues, skills.sh, GitHub and the MCP registry.
- [Full index as JSON](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/data/tools.json): name, kind, repo, description, installs, stars, growth, tasks, flags.

## Learn
- [This week in Claude](https://vishwaclaudema.vercel.app/week/): weekly changes, checked against Anthropic's pages.
